source.name: ANSUR II (2012 U.S. Army Anthropometric Survey), public release
source.rights: U.S. Government work released for public use; summary statistics only are stored here.
source.population: U.S. Army personnel aged 17–58; fitter and younger than the general population. Do not treat as children, elderly or world-population norms.
caveats: Female and male files are summarised separately, as the survey memo requires.
Group medians use the DoD race code and are descriptive of this sample only.
